caller_disagreement: child treats a false retirement reply as an unconfirmed end; parent returns that false flag as a retained value; the shallow reader can store an earlier failure without the full body
full_reader: current prefix schema consumed by the parent after a second seed join
ordinary_readers: shallow failure object stored with an empty reply
prefix writer and strict full reader, retirement false on both sides
parser: one framed JSON object, then row and token checks, then the four script values
producer: parent duplicates the response read end onto fd 0 before exec and sends one seed afterward
transport: child reads the seed on fd 0; later writes use the request write end learned from that seed
